propositions: Bridge preview/sync must become primary vocabulary while legacy reconcile adapters remain callable with their original defaults and filtering semantics

Legacy --mode and --filter-local-ids must retain documented behavior: argument-less reconcile stays dry-run, post-differ filtering works unchanged, Mode/MODE_CAPS remain available to old readers and workflows
Canonical --only/--except filters narrow differ inputs before execution, while legacy --filter-local-ids continues to filter writes after full examination
Selection must be validated before lock acquisition; any unresolved --only/--except token or disappeared preflight target must exit 2 without lock, differ, apply, or persist
Explicit --max-changes cap applies deterministic partitioning (10/100/uncapped) with corresponding applied/deferred manifests, while uncapped live removes temporary manifest unchanged
Direct engine, Python library, MCP bridge, and external-DC helper routes must route through shared normalized request parsing in request.py while maintaining their distinct entry-point defaults
